scope: Frozen finite validation rules for saved observations and a same-information native projection
source_requirement: Root-pinned same P1 lrc03 saved INITIAL and actual tool02 response, with original snapshot comparison and original relation context preserved

variants.name: renamed_ids_reordered
variants.rule: Rank original object IDs independently by SHA256(seed|id|ID), assign offline-r-NNNN IDs, name each object asset_ plus SHA256(seed|name|ID) first12hex, order objects by SHA256(seed|order|ID). Retarget stored relation pair IDs using the explicit map. Preserve geometry, facts and original context.

variants.name: proper_rotation_z90
variants.relation_rule: Preserve the existing three fact scalars and topology by exact isometry. Transform only explicit local_evidence triangle_vertices_world_m/point_world_m and surface_proximity.value.nearest_witness a/b/direction_a_to_b. Preserve all remaining fields. Keep original capture context with derived-fixture provenance.

variants.name: additional_same_shape_object
variants.clone_rule: Clone the object named by the first existing stored relation target_id. Assign offline-distractor-v1 and asset_distractor_v1. Preserve its faces and face_kind. Translate all world vertices by (2,0,0) with an exact Fraction-to-binary64 equality check. Keep every original object and original relation. Add no relation for the clone.

comparison_contract.native_policy: Same bundle, source binding, field selection, precision, compact output layout and existing relation facts. Batch reads and retained inputs are allowed equally.
comparison_contract.geometry_expectations: Independent saved source values and exact signed-coordinate transformations; no product output generates expected geometry or relations

generic_checks: source mismatch produces unknown with no selected payload
unknown object and unsupported object field remain explicit gaps
reversed or absent ordered relation is a gap
unavailable relation field is a gap
returned values do not mutate retained input
name is not guessed as an unrelated object ID
directory never expands vertices/faces or labels the task target
